body.p: Madeline Street was renamed in 1925 to Swanston Street and underwent a process of renumbering. Within the scope of our project we are looking at the West Side of Madeline/Swanston Street.
For more information see the Carlton Community History Group page on Madeline Street http://www.cchg.asn.au/name.html#madeline

The Mahlstedt fire survey plans, drawn between 1923 and 1928, already print the new Swanston Street numbers. On the west side each number is 516 above the old Madeline Street number for the same house: No. 599 is the old No. 83 and No. 629 the old No. 113. This matches the occupants listed under both names in the 1925 and 1930 directories. The plans also number the east side, Nos. 442 to 520.
